minutes.headline: Finance Committee split 2-2 on supporting the school's modified Primary School cooling plan; vote is advisory and fails.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the school department's request for support of a modified plan using ductless mini-split units at the Primary School in place of the original air conditioning project. Members debated process, scope, and lifespan, and the support motion failed on a tie; the chair noted the vote is advisory and the town manager decides. The committee also appointed members to the master plan steering committee and capital planning committee, set a summer schedule, and approved prior minutes.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee split 2-2 on whether to support the school department's modified Primary School cooling plan, so the support motion failed.
The chair noted the committee is advisory and cannot stop or force the project; the town manager, Select Board and School Committee are to weigh the result.
The motion was amended to use the amount town meeting appropriated, because the school's letter cited a different figure.
The modified plan uses ductless mini-split units in place of the original air conditioning project, whose engineer estimates ran far higher.
The committee appointed one member to the master plan steering committee and another to the capital planning committee, and set a summer meeting schedule.

why_it_matters: The Primary School cooling project may come back as a larger capital request needing a debt exclusion, which residents would be asked to vote on and which would draw on the town's limited debt capacity.
The tie leaves the Finance Committee without a recommendation, so the decision rests with officials who are not bound by its vote.
watch_next: Summer Finance Committee meetings on June 22, July 13 and 27, August 10 (tentative) and August 24, which are cancelled if there is no quorum.
Any decision by the town manager, Select Board or School Committee on the mini-split plan.
